scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:vue && npm run build:pages
scripts.build:pages: npm run build -w docs && npm run build -w vue-playground && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('apps/vue-playground/dist','apps/docs/dist/vue',{recursive:true})"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @jcdecor/ui && npm run test -w @jcdecor/vue
scripts.release: npm run build:ui && npm run build:vue && changeset publish
